narrativePost.fullText:
# LinkedIn Authority Post — Silent Customer & Dormancy Radar

Most companies lose 15–30% of their revenue not because of bad marketing, but because of silent workflow breakdowns.

We built **Silent Customer & Dormancy Radar** to solve this exact problem:
Inactivity detection telemetry that flags high-value accounts experiencing total login decay before they churn without filing support tickets.

### The Sentinel Claim Audit Registry
* **Benchmark Scenario:** Evaluated against synthetic multi-factor telemetry.
* **Demonstrated Latency:** Sub-millisecond calculation in zero-dependency Node.js runtime.
* **Live In-Browser Sandbox:** https://gideonbawa-website.netlify.app/simulators/silent-customer-detector/
* **Source Code:** https://github.com/bawagideon/silent-customer-detector

#SoftwareEngineering #B2B #Automation #SystemsEngineering #GideonHQ
